name: Yayoi Higashijujo
source:
A cheerful girl who belongs to the cheerleading club. She
has long hair with short pigtails.
She's not the type to stand out or excel at anything in particular,
but her naturally bright and positive personality makes her secretly popular with the boys (she's a little clumsy at times).

She's about 155cm tall and has a nice bust (around an E cup), which bounces up and down♪ She
has a crush on the protagonist (unrequited love), but he was so focused on his club activities that she didn't want to
get in his way and couldn't confess her feelings.

Then, after losing in the final competition, she tries to cheer up the protagonist, who is feeling empty inside...
